supporting_observations.claim: WS-LMARTINS-01 (10.40.10.22) made a series of connections to 10.40.20.30:8080, the inventoried explicit web proxy. The observed connections occurred at approximately five-minute intervals from 13:36 through 14:06 UTC.

The repeated connection timing is consistent with the inventoried PixelForge updater's roughly five-minute update checks, but the available records do not identify these connections as PixelForge activity.
The supplied Zeek records show workstation-to-proxy HTTP connections, not the ultimate external HTTPS destinations or the process responsible for initiating them.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection status reports a log-collection outage for WS-LMARTINS-01 winsec and Sysmon from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, preventing process attribution for the alerted interval.

The supplied collection status reports a proxy-log outage from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, so the external CONNECT destinations, proxy user-agent details, and inspected requests for the interval are unavailable.
Zeek connection telemetry is reported as available, but the provided records identify only the workstation's connections to the internal proxy.
claims_not_established: The external domains or services contacted by the periodic connections.
Whether PixelForge's updater, another approved application, a browser, or an unauthorized process initiated the connections.
Whether the connection contents or destinations were malicious, or whether data was transferred to an unauthorized service.
Whether the periodic connections were the same activity as the specific outbound HTTPS connections described by the alert.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs and upstream egress records for WS-LMARTINS-01 during 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, user-agent, and request details.
Recover endpoint process and network telemetry for the same interval to attribute the proxy connections to an executable and user.
Verify whether PixelForge Suite and its updater were installed and running on WS-LMARTINS-01 at the time, and compare updater logs or update-check records with the observed connection times.
